sources: https://www.dunlapmercantile.com/campgrounds/coops-creek-rv-campground (Dunlap Mercantile hat store's 'Visit > Campgrounds' directory post 'Written by Dolce In Dunlap', Aug 21; read 2026-11-24): 'Located 1 min (0.2 mi) via Rankin Ave and Pine Street from downtown Dunlap. Coops Creek RV Campground is a 10-slip RV hookup park with water, sewer, electric, and high-speed Wi-Fi.' No rate, no phone, no booking method - a third-party directory, not the operator's page.

Web search 2026-11-24 ('"Coops Creek RV" Dunlap Tennessee', '"Coops Creek" RV campground Dunlap TN rates'): no operator website, no booking engine and no rate found; results only list Coops Creek Cabins (an unrelated Hipcamp cabin rental) and R&R RV Campground.

Google Maps (headless browser, 2026-11-24): 'Coops Creek RV Park', 381 Walnut St, Dunlap, 4.8 from 6 reviews, phone +1 423-304-1208, no website, pin 35.3689736,-85.3902784. Reviews (all 6-8 months old): 'We stayed for Coops Creek Valley festival we were in site 1 very shady'; 'close to be within walking distance to festival grounds and area historical sites'; 'backs up to a cute walking path'; 'Wi-Fi is super!'

Esri World Imagery (sat.py r220 at 35.3703,-85.3904; satz.py z19 at 35.36897,-85.39010), 2026-11-24: a small gravel loop with ~6 RVs beside a red-roofed building at ~35.36895,-85.39012, with a creekside trail through the woods to the east; the stored pin 35.37175,-85.39049 falls on the US-127/Rankin Ave commercial strip downtown

note: Small RV park a short walk from downtown Dunlap, backing onto the Coke Ovens walking path along Coops Creek; reservations by phone. --Claude
